status: prescription_for_future_regeneration; installed historical tables have not yet been replaced
combined_source: sum absolute primary and additional cascade yields; primary excluded from cascade
normalization: Total-yield: N_AP/(N_POT epsilon^2), inclusive before geometric selection. DoubleDistr: normalized d2P/(dtheta dE), theta in radians, E and mass in GeV. Do not preselect theta_AP < 0.043.

bremsstrahlung_variation.rule: Hold Lambda_p and fragmentation coefficients fixed. Use the same pair coherently in primary and cascade. Keep each complete distribution and its integrated yield paired. F1-F2 interference can reorder the rates; table names do not imply pointwise ordering.
bremsstrahlung_variation.band: Envelope of observables calculated from the coherent pairs, not an envelope stitched cell by cell into a synthetic distribution.

drell_yan.variations: Separate coherent PDF and scale variants, using the manuscript prescription. Do not drop this uncertainty or combine it silently with the form-factor label.

validation_before_replacing_installed_ta: Inclusive normalization and nonnegative interpolated densities
Primary plus cascade equals combined, including acceptance weights
Reproduce manuscript theta_AP < 0.043 yields and energy spectra within sampling and interpolation precision
Resolve the light vector resonances in mass without interpolating over them
Preserve each source probability with its own angular-energy distribution

inelastic_dark_matter.rule: Preserve uncut mediator samples. Apply the angular cut to chi-prime after the polarized decay and integrate virtual pair mass with fixed daughter masses. An on-shell mediator table alone misses the finite-width effects.
